entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • High algorithmic complexity when parsing If-Match or If-None-Match header values containing many comma separators followed by an unparseable character #66668
  • Dynamic endpoint discards the original endpoint's metadata #66666
  • Normalize backslashes in PathDecoder #66665

Closed

  • RequireHost with wildcard matches "empty" subdomain #66581
  • Combine validation and deserialization errors #66653
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #66591
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #66592
  • Add StringSyntax formats throughout source code #44535
    Backlog
  • Can't define `@oncontextmenu` and `@oncontextmenu:preventDefault` on components #66667
  • Perf regression: json #65645
  • Perf regression: https, json, json #65593
  • Perf regression: https, json, mvc #65594

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix ValidationsGenerator CS8785 when AddValidation is called from multiple sites #66675
    needs-area-label
  • [Form binding] Fix parsing of malformed keys #66674
    area-blazor
  • Include scheme in certificate cache for Authentication middleware #66673
    area-auth
  • Add validation to ResponseCachingKeyProvider delimiter characters #66672
    area-middleware
  • Close connection after processing CL+TE #66671
    area-networking
  • Reduce algorithmic complexity for parsing If-Match and If-None-Match. #66670
    area-networking
  • HTTP 2/3: treat messages containing connection-specific header fields malformed #66669
    area-networking

Merged

  • Harden wildcard matching in HostMatcherPolicy. #66582
    area-networking, 11.0-preview5
  • feat: add missing [StringSyntax(DateTimeFormat)] to DateTimeOffset methods in BindConverter #66532
    community-contribution, needs-area-label, 11.0-preview5
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #66661
    area-networking, 9.0.x
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #66662
    area-networking

Updated

  • Make dotnet-user-secrets Native AOT compatible #66663
    area-commandlinetools

    area-infrastructure
  • Fix ValidationsGenerator ITypeParameterSymbol handling #65419
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal, feature-validation

    area-mvc, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun

    area-blazor

    community-contribution, area-middleware

    area-mvc, community-contribution
